definitions.ask: Should completed rows come from every vault note, including done/ archives, ref notes, and daily notes?
definitions.why: Most finished tasks live in done/ archives or ref notes; the catalog already exists

choices.label: All closed tasks the &/(( catalog finds: ~3.8k rows, ~170 ms per fetch
Only closed tasks from the notes / lists, plus their done/ archives

definitions.ask: When completed tasks are shown, should canceled tasks show too?
definitions.why: Both are closed history; the & and (( completed groups already include both

choices.label: Done and canceled tasks both list; canceled rows keep their glyph
Only done tasks list; canceled tasks stay hidden

definitions.ask: Should the toggle stay on for later / searches until you turn it off?
definitions.why: Open tasks are the usual target; a forgotten toggle would bury them

choices.label: Each new / draft starts open-only; the toggle lasts for that draft
The app remembers the last state until you toggle it off or quit
